title: Willamette Valley Wine Tour from Portland
includes: Pick-up & Drop-off At Downtown Portland, Oregon Hotels
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels

All southbound lanes of Interstate 5 through the Rose Quarter in Portland will close completely 24/7 starting at 10 p.m. on Friday, September 11, 2026, for up to five weeks. Due to the traffic delays this may cause, the tour could last up to one hour longer.
Must be 21 years of age to consume alcohol
Children ages 6 and under require a car seat for this tour; please bring your own, as the local operator cannot accommodate children without a car seat
REQUIRES MINIMUM OF 4 GUESTS TO OPERATE. Can be met by multiple groups booking.

Due to the nature of this tour and the safety of all guests, the tour operator reserves the right to refuse service to passengers who are intoxicated or show signs of intoxication. If, as a result, your tour is canceled, you will not be entitled to a refund.
America’s Hub World Tour’s works in collaboration with Oregon Tour Experts. All pickups are made via Oregon Tour Expert’s transportation and tour guiding company.
All guests will be required to sign an acknowledgement of the Safety Briefing that will be given at the start of the tour.
Please eat lunch prior to tour start time. Snacks are available for purchase at many wineries.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Go wine tasting near Portland in Willamette Valley, stopping at three wineries such as Blizzard Wines, Stoller Estate, ROCO Winery, Tresori Vineyards, Colene Clemens Vineyards, Holloran Vineyard Wines, Dobbes Family Winery, Domaine Serene, Durant Vineyards, and more. With more than 250 of Oregon’s wineries calling Willamette Valley home, there are plenty of varietals to suit individual tastes, from the region’s distinctive pinot noir to gold-medal chardonnay. With a knowledgeable and experienced guide, you'll visit a handpicked selection of small-town vineyards. Numbers are limited to 8 wine lovers on this small-group tour.
